#TechTipThursday: stop committing five unrelated things at once.

You fixed a bug, renamed a variable, and left a debug line in there. git add . takes all of it. Instead:

git add -p

Git walks the change hunk by hunk and asks about each one. y to stage it, n to skip, s to split it smaller.

Two minutes of work, and your history stops reading like a diary.

#Git #DevOps #CLI #Linux
